question: Do scene-graph relations improve next-instrument-set anticipation beyond entity history?
target: set of confirmed instrument onsets after eight seconds of absence
multi_instrument_rule: group confirmed onsets at the same timestamp into one target set
out_of_vocabulary_rule: retain event sets containing at least one eligible target, preserve all observed targets for audit, and score only targets in the training-derived vocabulary
interpretation_rule: A topology-specific interpretation requires gains in Recall@3 and sample-averaged mean average precision over the entity GRU, no-edge control and shuffled-edge control.
sensitivity_analysis: evaluate the fitted primary models on singleton-only test event sets
